reviews.text: Great App!. I am so thankful for this app! I keep my fragrance inventory here and that is wonderful to have on your phone! I love the scent of the day portion as well! It is so interesting to see what people are wearing and their thoughts. I also love the fact that you can now make comments on people’s post. I just wish that you received an alert for comments specifically. This would allow you to be aware if a question was asked or if you would like to respond. The only other item would be in the alerts and if someone liked your SOFD that you could click on their name and it brings you to their page and you can follow them. It just brings you to your post. It would be nice if you could see a list of who liked your SOTD. Small things but it would assist in the experience! Thank you so much for creating this app! I love it!!

reviews.text: Best perfume app. Love this app, they are constantly making upgrades and it gets better and better. Can’t wait to see what’s next!

Enjoying the app. I have been enjoying the app for a month now. I can keep track of my collection and wish list. Still, some recently fragrances in the market do not show in the app catalog. I have been adding them to the list of products that need to be included in Aromoshelf catalog. A great addition would be links from the wish list to retailers, discount stores, amazon etc

reviews.text: Good so far!. Great way to see the notes and what others think of certain fragrances! It would be nice to see the pictures people take of their fragrances. Like when they share them in SOTD I think it would be awesome to see what someone photographed themselves, if they did. Maybe even opening up comments on SOTD but I also wouldn’t want to open up any reason for hate to be put into the app. I do like that it’s very positive as well. But again maybe a little more interaction would be nice. Maybe even something like when someone shares their SOTD fragrances with similar DNA that people have in their shelves (so we know they’ve tested it) can be tagged in the SOTD post to show that maybe there’s another fragrance that that person may like if that makes sense. Anyways. Good app overall and I look forward to posting in it for people to see!

reviews.text:
Lacking inventory. This app has great potential. If you only have a department store collection, this should have most of your perfumes. If you have lots of niche or middle eastern perfumes, this will be a frustrating app. I’d say 1/2 of my 150 collection isn’t in their catalogue. They do offer the option to add perfume suggestions, but you’re at the mercy of their administrative dept to add them. I submitted probably close to 50 over a week ago, and I don’t see anything was added. And there isn’t an option to add it into your own collection until they add it. 

There are some annoying minor issues with the operation of it, but that can be ignored or accepted for the benefits of the app. However the lack of inventory combined with lack of speed to add fragrances (or at least add it immediately to your own collections until they add it at the company level) makes the app unusable. It would otherwise have a five star rating from me

reviews.text: So Useful!. This is a great app for the perfume lover that wants to keep track of what they, own, what they have tested,and what their impressions are without putting it in a spreadsheet. I was looking for how to add a fragrance that is not in the database (I only found one that wasn’t, Pine by Stora Skuggan), and was at a loss as to how to do this. That is my only complaint, and otherwise I am very satisfied. Well done!
